text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A powerhouse run by Agnes Digital!! The 
Wonder Girl of turf and dirt alike proves 
her strength once again here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuhaa*... I did it... I didn't even 
have the leeway to fan-girl mid-race... 
That was my... absolute... all...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The sky feels... so... far away...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Still, this light is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, so this is...
(Thump!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Digital-kun. Digital-kun, pull yourself 
together!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mm, mmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san... and Doto-san?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness~. I didn't know what I'd do 
if you didn't wake up...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Inexperienced as I am, I felt 
that if I didn't push myself to the limit 
today, I wouldn't be able to see the same 
view as the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Opera O-san, Doto-san, 
why are you two here?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean 'no matter what'? I was 
secretly watching before the race even 
began. Disguised as a passing merchant, of 
course."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I thought someone like me talking to you 
might just get in the way, so I didn't say 
anything in the paddock~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, then that presence earlier was...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I am beyond delighted...! For the two of 
you to go out of your way to come see me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! I feel like... in today's race, I 
finally understood a little bit!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Why is Opera O-san so brilliant, and why 
is Doto-san chasing her so radiant?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: At last... just a little bit...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Is that so? Well, I do believe my 
brilliance is simply innate.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“Yet if you revere me to such an extent, I 
shall grant you a glimpse of something 
even more dazzling.”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The very first co-starring performance 
between Doto and me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eh... Co-starring, don't tell me...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they're finally letting me enter a 
GⅠ! Even if I'm just tucked away in a 
corner of the field...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"At the Takarazuka Kinen, at long last, 
I'll be running with Opera O-san, whom I 
admire so much!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Guh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, Digital-san~?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What is that?! The sheer destructive power 
is off the charts! This god-tier event is 
on par with my fave playing a dome tour!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta cook some festive red rice and 
go watch this!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! By all means, do come. In 
exchange, however—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Digital-kun. Don't you also have a 
performance left to show us?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
From what I hear, you're an all-rounder 
who can perform on any stage, is that 
right?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was treated to a masterful 
performance on the turf. Which means... 
there ought to be another act to follow.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, there should be a 
perfect dirt race scheduled around the 
same time as the Takarazuka Kinen.

Speaking of major races close to the 
Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer. Seems like 
you've already kept a close eye on that 
area.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A token of gratitude... To return the 
favor to Opera O-san and Doto-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's somewhere I have to 
go...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"A nighttime social lounge... A racecourse 
where couples flirt and giggle— To 
'Another Tokyo'!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To the Japan Dirt Derby. Part of it 
is wanting to show Opera O and Doto, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That brilliance, that intense heat I saw 
at the NHK Mile Cup today...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to see if it makes any difference 
whether it's a turf G1 or a dirt G1. 
That's why!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please! Next time, let's go pay our 
respects to the strong dirt-track 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan doesn't mind any course or ship! 
Because I'm an omnivore!

I didn't quite get the metaphor, but we 
decided our next target would be the dirt 
GⅠ, the Japan Dirt Derby.
